dedupe_keys.name: city level water withdrawal and scarcity accounts of china

description: City level water withdrawal and scarcity accounts of China is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Zongyong Zhang et al. In the context of China’s freshwater crisis high-resolution data can inform sustainable water management and economic planning. Yet there is a dearth of data on water withdrawal and scarcity regardless of whether total or subsector amount, for prefectural cities. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2024. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
